claims: Continue continuous pulse oximetry monitoring with the low SpO2 alarm set at 92% and desaturation limit at 85%, given current O2 flow of 2 L/min and SpO2 99-100%.
Continue cardiac monitoring with ST segment monitoring and heart rate alarms (high 120, low 60) given prior tachycardia and current heart rate 75-91 bpm.
Continue non-invasive blood pressure monitoring with high/low alarms (160/90 mmHg) given prior blood pressure variability and current BP 94-115/54-74 mmHg.
Assess and manage moderate pain (reported 5/10, mild-moderate 3/10) with the existing PRN oxycodone and ketorolac orders, reassessing response.
Recheck serum magnesium given initial hypomagnesemia (1.5 mg/dL) and subsequent magnesium sulfate administration, to confirm normalization (last 2.8 mg/dL).
Monitor blood glucose given fingerstick 161 mg/dL and serum glucose 146-152 mg/dL, with hypoglycemia protocol range 70-100 mg/dL.
Continue venous thromboembolism and mobility precautions: bed rest with IV saline lock, Braden activity bedfast, and fall risk precautions.
Continue bowel regimen with docusate and bisacodyl as ordered, monitoring bowel function.
Continue monitoring for anxiety/agitation (RASS +1) and provide reassurance/environmental measures; PRN lorazepam and hydroxyzine are available if needed.
Maintain current respiratory support with 2 L/min nasal cannula and monitor respiratory rate (alarms high 35/low 8), currently 16-20 insp/min.
